name: BGP AS-Path Visualizer
desc: Paste BGP AS-paths and draw them as a diagram in your browser: see hops and origin, count prepends and detect loops. No lookups, no data sent, runs entirely client-side.

name: IPv4 & IPv6 Subnet / CIDR Calculator
desc: Calculate a CIDR block in your browser: network and broadcast address, netmask, wildcard mask, usable host range and count, for IPv4 and IPv6. Runs locally; nothing is sent.

name: Crontab Expression Tester
desc: Test a Unix cron expression in your browser: validate the 5 fields, read it in plain English, and see the next run times. Supports @daily and other macros. Nothing is sent.

name: DMARC Record Generator
desc: Build a valid DMARC DNS TXT record in your browser: policy, subdomain policy, pct, rua/ruf reporting, DKIM/SPF alignment and more. Explained tag by tag. Nothing is sent.

name: DNS Wire Format Parser
desc: Paste a DNS packet in hex and decode it in your browser: the 12-byte header and flags, QNAME labels, compression pointers and resource records (A, AAAA, CNAME). Nothing is sent.

name: Docker Compose Security Auditor
desc: Paste a Docker Compose file or run flags and scan for risky settings: privileged mode, the Docker socket, host namespaces, added capabilities, root user and more. Runs locally; nothing is sent.

name: IP Address Converter & Notation Transformer
desc: Convert IPv4 and IPv6 addresses between dotted-decimal, hexadecimal, binary, octal, integer (dword), RFC 5952 compressed, expanded, and reverse DNS PTR notations in local browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Nginx Configuration Linter & Security Auditor
desc: Audit, parse, and lint Nginx server blocks and reverse proxy configs offline in browser memory. Catch alias traversal bugs, proxy_pass trailing slash traps, missing semicolons, and TLS vulnerabilities.

name: SPF Record Deconstructor & Validator
desc: Deconstruct, parse, audit, and validate Sender Policy Framework (RFC 7208) TXT records entirely inside local browser memory. Audit DNS query lookup limits, mechanism qualifiers, CIDR blocks, and misconfigurations with zero network egress.

name: Syslog RFC 3164 & RFC 5424 Message Parser
desc: Dissect, calculate, and validate BSD RFC 3164 and IETF RFC 5424 syslog packets entirely in local browser RAM. Extract PRI, Facility, Severity, ISO 8601 timestamps, Structured Data, and payloads with zero network egress.

name: User-Agent Parser & Client Hint Analyzer
desc: Parse, deconstruct, and analyze User-Agent header strings, browser rendering engines, client operating systems, device classes, bot tokens, and User-Agent Client Hints (UA-CH) offline in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
